data.rationale: INTENT.md: problem clearly stated (no clean formal GTL engine), value prop clear (proof of GTL + bootstrap independence + reference implementation), scope bounded (V1, 6 features), non-trivial (self-hosting gate required)

feature_decomposition.md: 6 features cover all 14 REQ keys (verified via check-req-coverage 14/14), dependency DAG is acyclic (CORE → BIND+WKSP → CMD-*), MVP scope correctly includes all 6 features as minimum viable engine

ADR-001: GTL as spec (project+emit derive from event stream). ADR-002: bind_fd/bind_fp split specifies bind_fd + iterate loop. ADR-003: PrecomputedManifest+BoundJob structure complete. ADR-004: Scope type, no ambient inference. ADR-005: emit()+project() event stream rules. ADR-006: 6-phase bootstrap, V2 gated. All 6 core functions (iterate, project, emit, bind_fd, delta, schedule) derivable from the ADR set.

Design is clean and principled: GTL as constitutional language, two-phase bind reduces LLM attention to residual gap, Scope fails closed on ambiguity, event stream is append-only with system-assigned time. ADR-006 correctly gates all V2 features (spawn, consensus, release, observer) behind Phase 5 self-hosting.

140 tests pass (all F_D evaluators green: tests_pass, coverage_80, impl_tags, validates_tags, six_modules). All 6 functions implemented per ADRs: iterate+delta+schedule in schedule.py, project+emit+workspace_bootstrap in core.py, bind_fd+bind_fp in bind.py. PrecomputedManifest+BoundJob in manifest.py. gen-start+gen-iterate+gen-gaps in commands.py. Zero V2 features present (no spawn, consensus, release, multi-tenant). Domain-blind kernel proven (Phase B, 29 tests).
